title: Acceleration magnitude a₁
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a₁ = v/t = 2 m/s² from the acceleration phase data.

title: Acceleration magnitude a₂
description: Essential: Correctly calculates a₂ = v²/(2x) = 5 m/s² from the braking phase data.

title: Correct kinematic equation selection
description: Important: Applies v = u + at for acceleration phase and v² = u² + 2as (or equivalent) for braking phase.

title: Sign convention consistency
description: Important: Handles signs correctly for acceleration/deceleration, recognizing braking acceleration opposes motion.

title: Unit inclusion and consistency
description: Optional: Expresses final answers with correct units (m/s²) and maintains unit consistency throughout.

title: Incorrect equation mixing
description: Pitfall: Uses the same equation for both phases without adjusting for different known variables (e.g., tries to use v = u + at for braking without time).

title: Sign error in braking calculation
description: Pitfall: Forgets that final velocity is zero during braking or mishandles the negative sign in v² = u² + 2as, leading to incorrect a₂.
